summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of `tearDown()` being executed for classes marked with `unittest.skip` when running `pytest --pdb`. However, the patch introduces new test files (`test_normal_class.py`, `test_repro_skip_class.py`, `test_skip_method.py`) which are not part of the original diff and should be removed.

issues.description: The patch includes new test files (`test_normal_class.py`, `test_repro_skip_class.py`, `test_skip_method.py`) which are not part of the original diff and should be removed.
